sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "firms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "legal_name" TEXT, "business_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general' CHECK (business_kind IN ('general', 'kiryana', 'pharmacy', 'garments', 'cloth', 'hardware', 'electronics', 'restaurant', 'services', 'wholesale', 'mobile')), "ntn" TEXT, "strn" TEXT, "cnic" TEXT, "is_sales_tax_registered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_sales_tax_registered IN (0, 1)), "province" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'punjab' CHECK (province IN ('punjab', 'sindh', 'kpk', 'balochistan', 'ict', 'gb', 'ajk')), "address_line1" TEXT, "address_line2" TEXT, "city" TEXT, "phone" TEXT, "whatsapp" TEXT, "email" TEXT, "fiscal_year_start_month" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7 CHECK (fiscal_year_start_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12), "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PKR', "rounding_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'half_up' CHECK (rounding_mode IN ('half_up', 'half_even', 'truncate', 'ceil_abs')), "round_invoice_to_rupee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (round_invoice_to_rupee IN (0, 1)), "prices_include_tax" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (prices_include_tax IN (0, 1)), "raast_alias" TEXT, "bank_name" TEXT, "bank_account_title" TEXT, "bank_iban" TEXT, CHECK(firm_id = id)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'master' CHECK (device_role IN ('master', 'counter')), "platform" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('android', 'ios', 'windows', 'linux', 'macos', 'test')), "model" TEXT, "os_version" TEXT, "app_version" TEXT, "doc_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_this_device" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_this_device IN (0, 1)), "last_seen_at_utc" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (change_seq >= 0)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'manager', 'cashier', 'accountant')), "phone" TEXT, "pin_hash" TEXT, "pin_salt" TEXT, "biometric_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (biometric_enabled IN (0, 1)), "can_see_purchase_price" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (can_see_purchase_price IN (0, 1)), "can_see_margin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (can_see_margin IN (0, 1)), "max_discount_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (max_discount_bp >= 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)), "last_login_at_utc" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parties" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_search" TEXT NOT NULL, "party_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'customer' CHECK (party_type IN ('customer', 'supplier', 'both')), "party_group" TEXT, "phone" TEXT, "whatsapp" TEXT, "email" TEXT, "address_line1" TEXT, "address_line2" TEXT, "city" TEXT, "province" TEXT, "ntn" TEXT, "strn" TEXT, "cnic" TEXT, "buyer_registration_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unregistered' CHECK (buyer_registration_type IN ('registered', 'unregistered')), "is_on_atl" INTEGER CHECK (is_on_atl IN (0, 1)), "opening_balance_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_balance_as_of_local" TEXT, "credit_limit_paisa" INTEGER, "credit_days" INTEGER, "default_discount_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (default_discount_bp BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)), "price_tier" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'retail' CHECK (price_tier IN ('retail', 'wholesale', 'vip'))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "doc_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('sale_invoice', 'sale_return', 'purchase_bill', 'purchase_return', 'quotation', 'proforma', 'delivery_challan', 'sale_order', 'purchase_order', 'expense', 'other_income')), "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_series" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fiscal_year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "doc_date_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "doc_date_local" TEXT NOT NULL, "party_id" TEXT REFERENCES parties(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "party_name_snapshot" TEXT, "party_ntn_snapshot" TEXT, "party_strn_snapshot" TEXT, "party_address_snapshot" TEXT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'posted', 'void')), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1), "supersedes_id" TEXT REFERENCES documents(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "voided_by_id" TEXT REFERENCES documents(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "void_reason" TEXT, "subtotal_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "line_discount_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bill_discount_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "taxable_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "further_tax_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "withholding_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "extra_charges_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "round_off_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "paid_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "balance_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cost_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "prices_include_tax" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (prices_include_tax IN (0, 1)), "rounding_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'half_up' CHECK (rounding_mode IN ('half_up', 'half_even', 'truncate', 'ceil_abs')), "tax_rule_version" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v0', "place_of_supply" TEXT, "sale_type" TEXT, "salesperson_id" TEXT REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "notes" TEXT, "terms" TEXT, "vehicle_no" TEXT, "bilty_no" TEXT, "transporter" TEXT, "ship_to" TEXT, "supplier_bill_no" TEXT, "cash_threshold_breached" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cash_threshold_breached IN (0, 1)), "posted_at_utc" INTEGER, "location_code" TEXT, "fbr_status" TEXT CHECK (fbr_status IS NULL OR fbr_status IN ('pending', 'posted', 'rejected')), "fbr_invoice_no" TEXT, "fbr_error" TEXT, "fbr_posted_at_utc" INTEGER, CHECK(revision = 1 OR supersedes_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK(balance_paisa <= 0 OR party_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK(status <> 'posted' OR posted_at_utc IS NOT NULL)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "used_phone_buys" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "party_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parties(id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "seller_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(seller_name)) > 0), "seller_cnic" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(seller_cnic) = 13 AND seller_cnic NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'), "seller_phone" TEXT, "condition_note" TEXT) STRICT;
